sentences.text: As a commercial operator, you must report marine casualties to the Coast Guard.

Reportable casualties include an unintended grounding or striking a bridge; a loss of propulsion, steering or control that reduces the boat’s maneuverability; anything that affects the boat’s seaworthiness, such as a fire or flooding; a death; an injury that requires professional medical treatment beyond first aid; property damage over seventy-five thousand dollars; and significant harm to the environment.
